articles.title: Ted Lasso Season 4 Trailer Drops: A Women's Team, New Faces, and a Fresh Start
articles.summary: Ted Lasso returns August 5 on Apple TV, but this time he's coaching a women's second-division team. The trailer teases familiar charm, returning favorites, and a clever reset after a divisive season 3.

articles.title: Orcas Sink Another Yacht: Inside the 6-Year Mystery of Rudder-Ramming
articles.summary: A Swedish yacht lost its rudder to orcas off Spain, the eighth sinking since 2020. Researchers say the behavior is socially learned, not vengeful. Over 700 interactions have been logged, involving a critically endangered pod.

articles.title: Pompeii's Survivors? Tom Hiddleston's Docudrama Hunts for Escape Stories
articles.summary: National Geographic's 'Pompeii: Out of Time' follows three real people during the 79 CE eruption, blending archaeology and fiction. Hiddleston explores whether a teen, a businesswoman, and a soldier could have escaped.
